results.title: Introducing Interloc Informer, Part I
results.author: Aaron Hermes
highlights:
By: Aaron Hermes on June 24th, 2026
...
# Introducing Interloc Informer, Part I
...
We’ve gone through a bit of an evolution lately here at Interloc. Our flagship product, Mobile Informer, was getting a long in the tooth. First introduced in 2010, Mobile Informer had provided innovative mobile applications for Maximo to customers around the world for a decade and a half. In that time, IBM had introduced several new versions of Maximo, culminating with the release (in June 2020) of the Maximo Application Suite (MAS). Officially version 8.0, the name change from Maximo EAM to MAS reflected a renewed commitment to advancing the capabilities of the solution, including a significant change to the underlying infrastructure involved.
...
All of that is to say – we had a lot of catching up to do. New Maximo/MAS features, new technology, and a new model for how to deliver an all-in-one mobile solution that preserved the key elements of Mobile Informer that had made it the premiere choice for discerning enterprise customers for fifteen years. That work resulted in the UX Suite, which had a fully-redesigned look and feel. We introduced UX Suite at MaximoWorld in 2025, and initial feedback was overwhelmingly positive. After the official launch in November 2025, we immediately went back to work expanding the product’s feature set and refining the user experience based on feedback we were hearing from customers (and prospective customers!). New additions have included integrated Azure SSO support, ESRI GIS support, countbooks, routes, and more, but there are even brighter and shinier things on the horizon.
